title: New TV-style app store design
items: Redesigned the whole store into a TV-style layout — a side menu plus big poster-style cards, instead of the old top-tab layout
Added AK47 Sports, MovieBox and HD Streamz to Entertainment
Added a "Change Projector" option in the sidebar to quickly switch models without digging into Preferences
Entertainment now stays unlocked for 30 minutes after entering the code, instead of just 2
The Entertainment lock icon now shows amber while locked and turns green and open the moment it's unlocked, everywhere it appears
Fixed the sign-in screen so the on-screen keyboard no longer covers the username/code fields

title: Generate your own Entertainment code
items: The Entertainment unlock screen now has a "Generate my code" button — get instant access without messaging us, no need to wait for a reply
Self-generated codes are valid for 60 seconds, so they can't be shared around after the fact
